title: ConfigMap monitoring/ci-runner-governor-override, data decoded
description: Each data key is <host>.<family> and holds one JSON object as a string; this schema is the object form, each value parsed. One family per writer, written only with kubectl patch --type merge on its own key. governor.py reads every key through this file (conforms()), and `governor.py check-override <key> <value>` is how a writer's test checks what it writes. docs/runbooks/unity-ci-host.md, The override ConfigMap.

power.description: agent-web's Governor buttons: hold a powered host on or off until an epoch. An on is held to override_on_max_hours from the cycle the governor first sees it.

slots.description: machine-mode's pin: the host's admitted slots, its admitted local seats when local is set (a host with local_seats), and who set it. The one family with no end, since a workstation mode stands until the next switch.

reserve.description: machine-mode release-lane: pins the host to 0 until an epoch, over its slots pin.
